messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 — elevated 5xx error rate on /v1/chat/generate and /v1/embeddings (detected by anomaly-detector). Alerting on-call. https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/INC-2012346789 :rotating_light:
maria: acked. Paging in. I'm on it. What's the current customer impact?
raj: seeing ~18% 5xx on chat and ~30% on embeddings from 18:42-18:50 UTC. Rerank endpoints look fine.
sam: +1 on telemetry — p95 latency for chat jumped from 120ms -> 650ms around the same time.
maria: ok. quick triage: is this CPU/GPU saturation or serving runtime errors?
raj: infra metrics show GPU util is normal; highest resource is the CPU host handling request routing (spike in queue depth). Logs show many downstream 504s to quantized-model shard.
emily: I'm seeing a correlated surge in small embedding requests from a single IP block (suspected bot). That could be filling the routing queues.
maria: good catch. Proposal: apply per-endpoint emergency throttles. Tighten embeddings quotas first (less user-visible for latency-sensitive chat flows), limit burst and per-key qps. If that stabilizes, lift gradually. Any objections? :thinking_face:
sam: agree. also reduce chat max tokens to 512 at the proxy level to save GPU decoding time until we stabilize.
raj: ok plan. I'll execute the route-specific changes via control plane. Will run gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and watch error/latency.
ops-bot: COMMAND RUN: redwoodctl routes update --route embeddings.v1 --rate 30/s --burst 60 --scope global --reason "emergency throttle due to spike"
ops-bot: COMMAND RUN: redwoodctl routes update --route chat.v1 --max_tokens 512 --rollout 10% --reason "reduce decode work during incident"
maria: notifying status page + key customers for embeddings-heavy workloads. @support please prepare canned response explaining temporary quota reduction and mitigation steps.
emily: I've DM'd top-5 affected customers and flagged ones with SLAs. Support copy: "We're temporarily throttling embeddings traffic to protect platform stability. Reduced limits will be lifted as we validate traffic patterns."
sam: after the embeddings throttle at 18:47 UTC, embeddings error rate dropped from 30% -> 6% in 90s. Chat p95 improved to ~210ms after the chat max_tokens rollout to 10%.
raj: pushing chat rollout to 50% now. ops-bot: COMMAND RUN: redwoodctl rollout --route chat.v1 --to 50% --strategy canary
ops-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: chat.v1 at 50% (2023-10-12T18:50:40Z)
maria: good. next, add a route-specific rule to disallow the abusive IP block for embeddings for 1 hour. That should help tail noise.
emily: created ACL rule: `block 198.51.100.0/24` on embeddings edge.
raj: telemetry looks stable. Monitoring shows 5xx under 2% across endpoints and latency trending down.
sam: recommend keeping embeddings throttle at 30r/s and chat max_tokens at 512 for the next 30m while we run root cause. Also capture sample request IDs for replay.
maria: agreed. Start post-incident data collection: collect logs, sample requests, route counters, and config diffs. Put everything in the incident channel and start a follow-up ticket.
ops-bot: NOTE: change log for incident 2012346789 — embeddings rate set to 30/s, chat.max_tokens=512, ACL applied.
raj: handing off to @raj for next shift — I'll keep an eye for 10m then hand to on-coming oncall. @maria keep me in the loop for postmortem.
maria: thanks team. I'll open the incident ticket and draft initial timeline + mitigation actions.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 18:52:40 UTC.
emily: follow-up: the suspected cause looks like an aggressive polling client hitting embeddings with tiny inputs. We'll coordinate with product to add per-route cost-based quotas (tokens per second + request weight) to avoid similar future issues.
sam: +1 on request-weighted quotas. Also add a canary policy that excludes high-rate API keys from automatic large rollouts.
maria: noted. We're good to close the live mitigation phase. Final actions: keep throttles for 30m, collect artifacts, notify affected customers when fully resolved.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigations stable, monitoring green. Root-cause investigation ticket created: INC-2012346789-rca
raj: will pick up RCA. handing off to evening oncall.
maria: handoff to @raj complete. signing off. :white_check_mark:
